title: Dispatch: fail-closed obligation resolution and complete alternative partitions (attempt 6)
description:
Fresh full review of PR #475 at 68e5253: two P1 and two P2. THE DECOMPOSITION WAS
ACCEPTED — registry/authority findings went to eshyra-o9bd.19.1.12 and
scope/closure findings to .13, and were not counted against this PR. These
findings are inside the reduced per-clause boundary.

The contract has been REWRITTEN by the supervisor for the reduced scope (that
was finding 4, a supervisor error). Read `bd show eshyra-o9bd.19.1.1` — the
authority and closure requirements are gone, not annotated.

Because these are new findings inside the reduced boundary, the next review is a
FRESH FULL review.

=== FILES YOU OWN ===
  docs/adr/0020-source-clause-semantic-ir-and-completeness-contracts.md
  packages/core/src/rules/clauseIr/types.ts
  packages/core/src/rules/clauseIr/contracts.ts
  packages/core/src/rules/clauseIr/obligations.ts
  packages/core/src/rules/clauseIr/index.ts
  packages/core/test/clauseIrContracts.test.ts
  packages/core/test/clauseIrObligations.test.ts

=== F1 (P1): CAPTURED SATISFIES ON A MISSING OR UNKNOWN OBLIGATION ===
Supervisor-confirmed. contracts.ts ~line 815:
    const record = source.get(obligationId);
    if (record === undefined) return [];
An unresolvable obligation yields an EMPTY failure list, and line ~1024 computes
    captured: dimension(capturedFailures.length === 0, ...)
so zero failures reads as SATISFIED. A clause citing a nonexistent obligation is
therefore reported CAPTURED.

*** THIS IS THE FIFTH FAIL-OPEN IN THIS PROGRAM. *** The others: two finding-
registry closure predicates, the bootstrap ledger closure, and the prose
anti-template guard. The recurring idiom is exactly this — returning an empty
failure list when a lookup does not resolve, so "no failures" is
indistinguishable from "all checks passed".

FIX: an unresolvable obligation reference must FAIL CLOSED on EVERY dimension it
feeds, with a named reason distinguishing 'obligation not found' from 'obligation
satisfied'. Then AUDIT EVERY OTHER early return in this module for the same
shape — do not fix only the reported line. Add a test per dimension proving an
unknown obligation ID cannot yield a satisfied dimension.

=== F2 (P1): choice AND variant ALTERNATIVES NEED A COMPLETE PARTITION ===
Supervisor-confirmed. contracts.ts:231-232:
    choice:  requirements('choice',  count('choice','alternatives',1)),
    variant: requirements('variant', count('variant','alternatives',1)),
Only "at least one alternative" is required, so a DISCONNECTED exclusion graph
passes. Mutual exclusion across a set is a partition property; one member proves
nothing about it.
FIX: require the exclusion graph to be symmetric and fully connected across the
alternative set for choice and variant. Add tests for a disconnected graph, an
asymmetric pair, and a valid complete partition.

=== F3 (P2): EVIDENCE EQUALITY DEPENDS ON PROPERTY ORDER ===
contracts.ts:802 — `return JSON.stringify(evidence);` — so two evidence values
that differ only by property insertion order compare unequal.
FIX: structural comparison, order-independent. Add a test with the same evidence
built in two key orders.

=== PRESERVE ===
One obligation per clause; canonical base requirements; facet implication
closure; the complete timing facet vocabulary; independent readiness dimensions
with capability failures on SUPPORTED; CAPTURED restricted to source evidence;
the closed engine:F1..F10 identity with ownership by bead identity; the 13-line
non-authoritative ObligationSource interface — do NOT reintroduce a validating
registry, scope, or closure surface, and do not absorb work owned by
eshyra-o9bd.19.1.12 or .13.

=== ENVIRONMENT / CONSTRAINTS ===
npm ci first; npm run verify:worktree BEFORE committing. Edit only the files
above. Do not touch package.json, internal.ts, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .github/,
or any script/CI file. Do not regenerate the pack or run the importer. Do not
modify any bead but your own; no bd dolt push; no push, PR comment, or merge.
The PR body and bead contract are the supervisor's to maintain.
acceptance_criteria:
• An unresolvable obligation reference fails closed on every dimension, with a reason distinguishing not-found from satisfied; a test per dimension proves it.
• Every other early return in the module is audited for the same fail-open shape, not just the reported line.
• choice and variant require a symmetric, fully connected exclusion graph; disconnected and asymmetric cases fail, with tests.
• Evidence equality is structural and order-independent, with a two-key-order test.
• No validating registry, scope, or closure surface is reintroduced; no .12 or .13 work is absorbed.
• npm run verify:worktree passes.
